scientific_integrity: Direct orbit and lifted-cycle proof; independent small-case code corroboration, not a computational proof for all finite groups. Matroid shellability and Tutte theory are previously known.
scientific_limitations: Complete simple undirected graph and a free finite-group action on vertices are required. The PL identification does not specify residual normalizer representations; older voltage-graph literature may contain an equivalent description. A same-model mathematical review is not independent verification.
title: Free finite symmetries of complete-graph forest complexes: a coned-multigraph model
